signals.summary: Sage let go of its entire remaining workforce of 338 employees, effective Aug. 22, after the Supernus acquisition.
Supernus Pharmaceuticals acquired Sage in a deal worth $591 million, potentially up to $795 million with milestones.
Biogen proposed buying Sage for $469 million in January; Sage rejected the offer as undervaluing the company.
